content.title: UConn's comeback bid falls short against Michigan in NCAA championship
content.text: 11:20 pm ET April 6, 2026FINAL: Michigan 69, UConn 63Jason SnowMichigan is the king of college basketball for the first time in 37 years.Elliot Cadeau led the Wolverines with a game-high 19 points, 3 rebounds and 2 assists. Yaxel Lendeborg powered through injury to score 13 and Morez Johnson Jr. posted a double-double of 12 points and 10 rebounds.UConn boasted four double-digit scorers in the defeat -- Alex Karaban (17), Tarris Reed Jr. (13 points, 14 rebounds), Braylon Mullins (11) and Solo Ball (11).11:19 pm ET April 6, 2026UConn draws up play for KarabanJason SnowMichigan 67, UConn 63 -- :13.4 second half:The Huskies draw up a play for Alex Karaban to spring free for a 3-point look from the left wing and the shot draws the front rim. Trey McKenney digs out the rebound for Michigan.UConn coach Dan Hurley is appealing the play for a potential elbow thrown by McKenney on UConn's Malachi Smith on the rebound. The appeal is not successful, and UConn loses its final timeout.11:16 pm ET April 6, 2026Michigan fouledJason SnowMichigan 67, UConn 63 -- :29 second half: UConn grabs Michigan's Roddy Gale Jr. to stop the clock. He misses both free throws.11:14 pm ET April 6, 2026UConn's Solo Ball rises in clutchJason SnowMichigan 67, UConn 60 -- :37 second half:The UConn press forces a Michigan turnover, and Solo Ball banks home a 3-pointer from the left wing on a dish from Braylon Mullins. Ball has 10 points (4-for-10 from field; 2-for-6 from deep).11:11 pm ET April 6, 2026Karaban hits two free throws for UConnJason SnowMichigan 67, UConn 60 -- :53 second half: The senior captain hits two free throws. He has 17 points for the game. UConn's Malachi Smith forces a jump ball on the inbound pass, and the possession arrow points in Michigan's direction. Timeout on the floor.11:09 pm ET April 6, 2026UConn's Silas Demary Jr. fouls outJason SnowMichigan 67, UConn 58 -- 1:07 second half: The junior guard bumped Michigan's Elliot Cadeau near half court to pick up his fifth personal foul. Demary Jr. leaves with 2 points. Cadeau drops in both free throws.11:07 pm ET April 6, 2026Trey McKenney, clutch 3-pointer for MichiganJason SnowMichigan 65, UConn 56 -- 1:49 second half:After a missed layup by UConn's Solo Ball on one end, Michigan's McKenney pours on a 3-pointer in transition on the other. McKenney has 7 points on 2-for-9 shooting tonight.11:05 pm ET April 6, 2026Karaban clutch for UConnJason SnowMichigan 62, UConn 56 -- 2:20 second half:The senior captain comes through with a much-needed 3-pointer from the top of the key as UConn draws closer.11:04 pm ET April 6, 2026Mullins, Demary Jr. whistled for foulsJason SnowMichigan 60, UConn 53 -- 2:45 second half: Mullins commits an offensive foul on one end, his second foul, and Demary Jr. commits his fourth on the other end. Both players stay in.10:56 pm ET April 6, 2026UConn's Mullins fires away againJason SnowMichigan 58, UConn 51 -- 4:30 second half: In response to a layup by Michigan's Yaxel Lendeborg, the freshman Mullins receives a cross-court dish from Alex Karaban and funnels down another 3-pointer. Mullins is up to 11 points on 4-for-16 shooting from the field (3-for-9 from deep).10:53 pm ET April 6, 2026Braylon Mullins hits from deep for UConnJason SnowMichigan 56, UConn 48 -- 5:21 second half: The freshman steps up and buries a 3-pointer from the left wing. He has 8 points on 3-for-15 shooting.10:51 pm ET April 6, 2026Alex Karaban to the free-throw lineJason SnowMichigan 54, UConn 45 -- 6:04 second half: Braylon Mullins scoops up an offensive rebound and kicks it out to Karaban, who drives right and draws a foul. The senior, an 86% free-throw shooter, missed both.10:43 pm ET April 6, 2026UConn's Silas Demary Jr. back inJason SnowMichigan 50, UConn 45 -- 8:15 second half: The junior guard is back in action after sitting with three fouls. He drives the lane and lays it in to cut the Huskies' deficit to five.10:41 pm ET April 6, 2026Michigan imposing its willJason SnowMichigan 50, UConn 41 -- 9:48 second half: Yaxel Lendeborg rejects a UConn layup at the rim on one end, and Morez Johnson Jr. finishes another put-back. Johnson Jr. has 12 points and 9 rebounds.10:28 pm ET April 6, 2026Michigan commands its largest leadJason SnowMichigan 48, UConn 37 -- 12:47 second half: A 3-pointer by Michigan's Elliot Cadeau is down the hatch. It's the Wolverines' first hit from distance tonight (1-for-11). Cadeau is up to 15 points.10:19 pm ET April 6, 2026UConn's Solo Ball picks up fourth foulJason SnowMichigan 38, UConn 31 -- 16:20 second half:Ball picks up his fourth foul while reaching in on a layup attempt by Michigan's Elliot Cadeau, who converts an and-one. Jayden Ross subs in.10:16 pm ET April 6, 2026Silas Demary Jr. in foul troubleJason SnowMichigan 35, UConn 31 -- 17:24 second half:The UConn backcourt of Silas Demary Jr. and Solo Ball each have three fouls. Malachi Smith checks in for Demary Jr.9:54 pm ET April 6, 2026Yaxel Lendeborg: "I feel really super weak."Chris McDanielMichigan's Yaxel Lendeborg didn't hold back when sideline reporter Tracy Wolfson asked him how he felt about his play in the first half."I feel awful, I feel super weak right now," Lendeborg said. "I can't make anything. Oh man, I'm trying to push through obviously because it's the championship game."The Big Ten Player of the Year played all 20 minutes in the first half, but was 1-for-5 from the floor 4 points but no rebounds, assists, steals or blocks. He also has 2 fouls."No matter what type of knee pain I'm in, I've got to go out there and give it my best," said Lendeborg. "I played really soft that first half. I'm going to be way better in the second half."In the semifinal win over Arizona on Saturday, Lendeborg suffered a bone bruise, sprained MCL and an ankle injury.9:51 pm ET April 6, 2026HALF: Michigan 33, UConn 29Jason SnowMichigan's Roddy Gayle Jr. powers down an explosive put-back dunk with 24 seconds left in the half, and UConn's Tarris Reed Jr. hits one of two free throws in the waning seconds.Michigan's Morez Johnson Jr. leads all scorers with 10 points and 4 rebounds. Alex Karaban and Solo Ball lead UConn with 8 points apiece.UConn center Tarris Reed Jr. has 5 points, 6 rebounds and 2 fouls. Michigan center Aday Mara has 6 points, 2 rebounds and zero fouls.Michigan is shooting 11-for-30 from the field; UConn is 10-for-30.UConn is 5-for-15 from deep; Michigan is 0-for-8.Michigan has 22 points in the paint; UConn has 8.Michigan is 11-for-12 from the free-throw line; UConn is 4-for-6.9:43 pm ET April 6, 2026Timeout UConnJason SnowMichigan 29, UConn 25 -- 2:24 first half: Dan Hurley opts to regroup after the Wolverines put together a quick 6-0 run. Prior to this, Michigan missed eight of its last nine shots.9:40 pm ET April 6, 2026Flagrant foul called on UConn's Alex KarabanJason SnowUConn 25, Michigan 23 -- 3:16 first half: Officials go to replay review and determine that a flagrant-1 will be assessed to UConn's Alex Karaban after the senior forward locked his arm with Michigan's Morez Johnson Jr. while boxing out to pursue a defensive rebound. It's Karaban's first foul.9:34 pm ET April 6, 2026Key foul called on UConn's Tarris Reed Jr.Jason SnowUConn 25, Michigan 23 -- 3:58 first half: The Huskies' senior center picks up his second foul while setting an illegal screen. He has 4 points and 4 rebounds on 2-for-7 shooting in 12 minutes played.Back-up Eric Reibe, who has played 35 total minutes in the four prior rounds, has seen four minutes of action tonight.9:30 pm ET April 6, 2026How many NCAA championships has Michigan basketball won?Chris McDanielMichigan basketball is vying for its second NCAA championship on Monday against UConn.The Wolverines other title came in 1989. It hasn't been for a lack of trying as Michigan is 1-6 all-time in the championship. The Wolverines lost in the final game in 1965, 1976, 1992, 1993, 2013 and 2018.Michigan's last championship appearance was a 79-62 loss to Villanova. In that loss, Donte DiVincenzo led the Wildcats by scoring 31 points, highlighted by 5 3-pointers. Michigan's roster that season included future NBA players Mortiz Wagner, Duncan Robinson and Jordan poole.9:28 pm ET April 6, 2026See the first half (so far) in photosChris McDaniel9:26 pm ET April 6, 2026Dan Hurley stunned by foul callJason SnowUConn 18, Michigan 17 -- 6:47 first half:It was a rather calm reaction for the UConn head coach, but Hurley was shown in disbelief after Braylon Mullins was whistled for a foul after tying up Michigan's Nimari Burnett in pursuit of an offensive rebound.9:16 pm ET April 6, 2026UConn leadsJason SnowUConn 16, Michigan 15 -- 10:05 first half:Another Alex Karaban 3-pointer, his second, hands the Huskies their first lead of the game. The senior hit this one from the left corner on a dish from Malachi Smith.9:15 pm ET April 6, 2026How many NCAA championships has UConn basketball won?Chris McDanielUConn men's basketball has never lost in the NCAA championship. The Huskies entered Monday's showdown with a perfect 6-0 record in the national championship.UConn won national titles in 1999, 2004, 2011, 2014, 2023 and 2024.The Huskies are trying to become the first team since UCLA to win three titles in four years. The Bruins last accomplished the feat by winning seven consecutive titles under coach John Wooden from 1967-1973.Kentucky won the title in 1996 and 1998, but lost in the 1997 championship.Duke was the runner-up in 1990 and followed that up with titles in 1991 and 1992 with a Final Four trip in 1994.9:10 pm ET April 6, 2026Alex Karaban is on the board for UConnJason SnowMichigan 11, UConn 10 -- 12:20 first half: The senior captain pump fakes, steps to the side and gets his first 3-point attempt to drop.He went a combined 3-for-18 from the field (2-for-13 from deep) in the two previous rounds vs. Duke and Illinois.9:06 pm ET April 6, 2026Elliot Cadeau starring for MichiganChris McDanielMichigan junior point guard has upped his play in the NCAA Tournament. He's averaging 11 points and 8.6 assists per game during the tourney.The 6-1 New York native transferred to Michigan before the season after spending the first two years of his career at North Carolina. Cadeau has started 108 of his 114 collegiate games, coming off the bench 6 times as a freshman.9:05 pm ET April 6, 2026Solo Ball is on target for UConnJason SnowMichigan 9, UConn 7 -- 13:56 first half: Solo Ball, who did not participate in Sunday's practice with an ankle injury, drills a 3-pointer from the top of the key. He has the last five points for the Huskies.9:00 pm ET April 6, 2026Michigan using its size on the offensive glassJason SnowMichigan 9, UConn 4 -- 16:00 first half:Michigan's Morez Johnson cleans up an offensive rebound and lays it home. Roddy Gayle Jr. rejects a shot by UConn's Silas Demary Jr. on the other end.8:52 pm ET April 6, 2026Michigan vs. UConn predictionsJason SnowChris McDaniel: Michigan 76, UConn 65 — The Huskies keep it close in the first half, and maybe even lead at the break. But Michigan's size puts Tarris Reed Jr. in foul trouble, allowing the Wolverines' height advantage to take the game over. Jason Snow: UConn 62, Michigan 60 — A methodical offensive approach and collective effort defending the paint swings another March Madness thriller in UConn's favor. Solo Ball has his best game of the tournament.8:45 pm ET April 6, 2026Who are the announcers for UConn vs Michigan?Chris McDanielThe same crew that called the Final Four will be calling the NCAA championship.Ian Eagle will handle play-by-play duties while joined by color analysts Bill Raftery and Grant Hill. Tracy Wolfson is the sideline reporter and Gene Steratore is the rules analyst.8:30 pm ET April 6, 2026UConn's Alex Karaban is an all-time winnerChris McDanielUConn senior forward Alex Karaban will wrap up his storied college career as one of the most-accomplished winners in NCAA Tournament history.Karaban, a native of Southboro, MA, is trying to become the first non-UCLA player to win three national titles in four years.Karaban heads into Monday's national championship with a record of 18-1 in the NCAA Tournament. The lone loss came against eventual champion Florida in the Round of 32 last season. Karaban is currently tied for the second-most NCAA Tournament wins all time. That tie happens to be with coach Dan Hurley's brother, Bobby Hurley (Duke). Only Duke's Christian Laettner has more with 21.7:45 pm ET April 6, 2026Dan Hurley's March Madness historyJason SnowDuring Dan Hurley's tenure (2019-present), the Huskies have qualified for six NCAA Tournaments with an overall record of 18-3 and repeat national titles in 2023 and '24.Hurley's career .800 winning percentage in March Madness (20-5 record) — which includes one trip made while coaching at the University of Rhode Island — is the highest among active coaches, and third-highest in college basketball history (minimum 15 games), only behind San Francisco's Phil Woolpert (13-2, two national titles) and UCLA's John Wooden (47-10, 10 national championships).7:37 pm ET April 6, 2026Michigan's Yaxel Lendeborg injury updateJason SnowMichigan's Yaxel Lendeborg is not listed on the official NCAA injury report.Lendeborg, a senior forward, suffered a sprained MCL of his left knee and an injured ankle in the Wolverines' 91-73 win over Arizona on Saturday. Lendeborg played 14 minutes and scored 11 minutes in the win.On Sunday, April 5, Lendeborg told reporters that he feels great and planned to "give it a go."Michigan lists sophomore L.J. Cason and freshman Winters Grady as out for Monday's national championship game.7:30 pm ET April 6, 2026Why does the NCAA championship start so late?Chris McDanielThe 8:50 p.m. (EST) tip-off for the NCAA basketball championship between UConn and Michigan certainly raises eyebrows, especially on the east coast.Well, the start time is actually earlier than it used to be. The 2024 NCAA championship, also UConn's last appearance, didn't tip off until 9:20 p.m.The NCAA hasn't released any official answers into why the game starts so late, but it's safe to assume the goal is to get as many viewers from across the country. An 8:50 p.m. tip on the east coast, is a 5:50 p.m. tip on the west coast.7:24 pm ET April 6, 2026UConn's Solo Ball injury updateJason SnowUConn's Solo Ball is not listed on the official NCAA injury report.The junior combo-guard was in a walking boot during practice on Sunday and did not participate. Coach Dan Hurley told reporters that Ball sprained his foot early in the Huskies' 71-62 win over Illinois on Saturday.Ball played 28 minutes, including 16 in the second half, and scored 13 points in the victory.UConn submitted a clean injury report ahead of the national championship game.7:20 pm ET April 6, 2026Michigan basketball rosterChris McDaniel0, Ricky Liburd, FR, G/F - Hollywood, Fla.1, Trey McKenney, FR, G - Flint, Mich.2, L.J.
